messages.subject: time as iterator
parts:
I am trying to loop through growth models in which the intercept is centered at each time point. Can you tell me why following is not working?

[[init]]
iterators = time;
time = 1:5;
timenames#time =  "0-center"  "1-center"  "2-center"  "3-center"  "4-center";
time1name#time =  0  -1  -2  -3  -4;
time2name#time = 1 0  -1  -2  -3;
time3name#time = 2 1 0  -1  -2;
time4name#time = 3 2 1 0  -1;
time5name#time = 4 3 2 1 0;
[[/init]]

MODEL:
i l q | g3f@[[time1name#time]] g3w@[[time2name#time]] g3s@[[time3name#time]]
g4f@[[time4name#time]] g4w@[[time5name#time]];
